name: PostgreSQL to Google Sheets
steps:
1.  Create a data model and specify the [data warehouse](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/destinations/index.html) from which you want the data for your Google Sheets. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [data warehouse](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/destinations/index.html#_datachannel_managed_warehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
2.  Authorise DataChannel to connect to your Google Sheets.
3.  Click on **\+ Data Sync** to start adding data syncs to your account.

![googlesheets reverseetl](/images/cms/reverse-etl-destinations/googlesheets-reverseetl-93ff48.png)

     4.  Details of individual syncs are available [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/googlesheets/syncs.html).
